nitrate_samples.csv.pwsid: Original EPA PWS identifier, including numeric federal/tribal IDs
nitrate_samples.csv.stage: raw, finished_or_entry, unresolved, or conflict by available source/point codes
nitrate_samples.csv.nitrate_lower: Detected result or zero for a usable left-censored observation
nitrate_samples.csv.nitrate_upper: Detected result or sample-specific reporting limit for a censored observation
nitrate_samples.csv.nitrate_mid: Detected result or reporting limit divided by sqrt(2), descriptive substitution only
nitrate_samples.csv.eligible: Community (C), routine (RT), and usable numeric result/limit
nitrate_samples.csv.limit_mg_l_as_n: Detection/reporting limit converted independently from result unit
nitrate_samples.csv.data_class: observed_epa_syr4; see acquisition hash for provenance
nitrate_samples.csv.native_fields: Preserved; definitions in EPA user guide

nitrate_quarterly.csv.nitrate_mid: Equal-point mean of within-point sample means
nitrate_quarterly.csv.observed_max: Maximum sample upper value; not continuous peak
nitrate_quarterly.csv.exceed5_upper: Any sample upper bound >5; differences between bounds indicate censoring uncertainty

nitrate_annual.csv.n_quarters: Number of quarters with observations; never imputed

coverage_grid.csv.unit: 845 community systems appearing in release x eight calendar years
coverage_grid.csv.observed: At least one eligible sample across any stage
coverage_grid.csv.missing: No outcome is filled; counts remain missing when unobserved
